title: Shaffy OS profile
description: A profile.yaml: a small public bundle of settings a supplement vendors under profiles/OWNER/NAME/ and lists in config.yaml (docs/PROFILES.md). It adds fragments, files, packages, editor extras, plugins and MCP servers; it never sets a value the machine has only one of.

schema_version.description: Version of this settings format. Shaffy OS refuses versions it does not know.

description.description: What the profile sets up, in one line, for the person who reads the review.

minimum_release.description: The oldest Shaffy OS release these settings work with, as its tag: vYYYY.MM.DD, or vYYYY.MM.DD.N for a later release that day. A checkout whose newest release tag is older is refused.

requires.description: Integrations from defaults/integrations.yml that config.yaml must set to managed for this profile to apply; a profile never sets their state.

mcp_servers.description: MCP servers merged into the Claude Code, Claude Desktop and Codex configurations; a name overrides or extends the default of the same name. Set enabled to false to remove that server from every configuration.

claude_plugins.description: Claude Code plugins installed and enabled beside pstack: each PLUGIN@MARKETPLACE names the GitHub repository (OWNER/REPO) of its marketplace, which may not be pstack's own. Deleting a name leaves that plugin as it is.

assets.description: Files copied into the home, such as fonts, styles and filters: each key is a target under ~/, each value a file inside the profile, or {file, executable, private}. config.yaml's entry for a target replaces it.

private.description: Install readable by the user only.

extras.description: LazyVim extras enabled beside the public ones, by module name (for example lazyvim.plugins.extras.lang.ruby). The language tools they declare install through Mason; plugins of their own outside the public lock stay unpinned.

overrides.description: Native fragments, each a file in the profile, loaded after the public configuration and before the supplement's own, in the order config.yaml lists the profiles. They are trusted configuration and may run commands.

niri.description: Installed as ~/.config/niri/profiles/NN-OWNER-NAME.kdl, NN the profile's place in config.yaml's profiles list; profiles.kdl includes it, in list order, just before the supplement's user.kdl.

noctalia.description: Installed as ~/.config/noctalia/96-profile-NN-OWNER-NAME.toml, NN the profile's place in config.yaml's profiles list; Noctalia reads it after the public 90 to 95 files and before the supplement's 97-supplement.toml.

fish.description: Installed as ~/.config/fish/profiles/NN-OWNER-NAME.fish, NN the profile's place in config.yaml's profiles list; profiles.fish sources it, in list order, just before the supplement's supplement.fish.

alacritty.description: Installed as ~/.config/alacritty/profiles/NN-OWNER-NAME.toml, NN the profile's place in config.yaml's profiles list; profiles.toml imports it, in list order, just before the supplement's supplement.toml.

mise.description: Installed as ~/.config/mise/conf.d/80-profile-NN-OWNER-NAME.toml, NN the profile's place in config.yaml's profiles list; mise reads it before the supplement's 90-supplement.toml, which wins a tool or setting both name.

keyboard_hwdb.description: System scope: a keyboard model's key map, matched by its vendor and product and never by a port, a unique id or a serial; installed in /etc/udev/hwdb.d/90-shaffy-keyboard.hwdb before the supplement's map, which wins.

packages.description: Packages on top of the public groups in defaults/packages/; one a group already installs is skipped with a note, and config.yaml's packages.omit may leave one out.

enabled.description: Defaults to true. False removes this named MCP entry on home apply; omitting a server from settings leaves any existing entry alone.

command.description: Program to start; a leading ~/ means the target home directory.

url.description: Address of a streamable HTTP server that runs on its own, instead of a command. Claude Desktop's configuration holds commands only, so it leaves such a server out.

reference.description: A file inside the profile, relative to its folder.
